One of the things I have to do for [M. de Normanville](/person/1088)[^1] is to write a story in French, and [my story](/book/1) goes on for ever and ever . . . my poor little girls meet with all sorts of dangers.


[^1]: F. de Normanville (b. 1770/1), her French and Italian teacher, an émigré from the French Revolution.
